jobs.title: ATE Software Engineer
jobs.description: ﻿ ATE Software Engineer | Drivenets Home » Careers » ATE Software Engineer ATE Software Engineer GSC Raanana, Israel Full-time Description About DriveNets DriveNets is a leader in high-scale networking software for AI infrastructure and service providers. The company pioneered a disaggregated networking architecture that transforms the economics of large-scale networks while maximizing performance, utilization, and operational efficiency. DriveNets-powered networks are deployed by global leaders, including AT&T and Comcast, supporting more than 30% of total U.S. internet traffic. DriveNets AI Fabric delivers full-stack networking for AI infrastructures, providing the highest-performance, Ethernet-based alternative to InfiniBand. The solution is deployed by hyperscalers, NeoClouds, and enterprises worldwide. With over $1B raised, DriveNets continues to push the boundaries of modern networking infrastructure. ﻿About the Role We are seeking a senior ATE Software Engineer to design, build, and deploy our next-generation automated manufacturing test platform for advanced telecom, high-density switching, and optical networking hardware. In this role, you will bridge the gap between R&D hardware/firmware teams and high-volume manufacturing lines. You will take ownership of ingesting, refactoring, and consolidating disparate R&D scripts, diagnostic tools, and legacy software into a single, scalable, production-grade test platform. We expect you to leverage modern AI-assisted development tools and workflows to maximize engineering efficiency, accelerate delivery timelines, and build highly robust, self-healing test automation. You will deploy test stations across global Contract Manufacturers (EMS/ODM), actively stabilize production lines through bring-up and ramp-up, and drive continuous test maintenance and root-cause failure analysis (RCA). Key Responsibilities Test Platform Architecture & Software Development: Design, develop, and productize robust, modular test software frameworks for board-level (PCBA) and system-level manufacturing testing across multiple product lines and manufacturing sites. Codebase Unification & Refactoring: Consolidate and standardize R&D diagnostic libraries, silicon validation scripts, and firmware tools developed across various environments ( Python, C# / Visual Studio, VB, ATEasy, Linux ) into a unified, maintainable test execution engine. AI-Accelerated Development & Workflow Automation: Actively integrate Generative AI tools and AI coding agents into your daily workflow to accelerate code conversion/refactoring, automate test case synthesis, generate edge-case validation scripts, and enhance overall codebase resilience. Production Line Deployment & Stabilization: Deploy test stations and fixtures to local and overseas EMS/CM production lines. Monitor, debug, and fine-tune test execution during NPI and ramp-up phases until yield, takt time, and test stability targets (CPK / First Pass Yield) are achieved. Failure Investigation & Intelligent RCA: Investigate complex system-level and component-level test failures. Utilize advanced log analysis, structured telemetry, and pattern recognition to drive root-cause investigations and implement preventive software/hardware fixes. Ongoing Test Maintenance & Optimization: Provide continuous operational Production line support and maintenance, bug fixes, software updates, and station cycle-time optimizations for active mass-production lines. R&D Collaboration & Test Specification: Collaborate closely with Hardware, Firmware, and Validation teams during early design phases to define test specifications, drive Design for Testability, Documentation & Technical Reporting: Author and maintain comprehensive testing documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), test coverage matrices, and detailed failure analysis reports. Manufacturing Systems Integration: Integrate automated test sequences with CM’s SFC/MES/QMS, serialized tracking, and central test log databases. Log Analysis & Analytics Tool Development: Design and build dedicated log parsing, data visualization, and diagnostic analytics tools to streamline complex hardware/software debugging, accelerate root-cause analysis (RCA), and drive continuous production line cycle-time and yield optimization. Requirements B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of hands-on experience in ATE software development and production test engineering for complex telecom, networking, or optical hardware products. Advanced, everyday practical mastery of AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM-based coding agents, automated prompt-driven refactoring) to radically accelerate code delivery, debug legacy systems, and enforce code quality. Strong software engineering skills in Python and Linux environments. Practical experience with test development in C# (.NET / Visual Studio) , VB , or specialized test sequencers such as ATEasy . Proven track record of deploying, commissioning, and stabilizing ATE test benches at overseas tier-1 EMS/CM facilities. Strong grasp of digital and communication protocols (PCIe, I2C, SPI, MDIO, UART, Ethernet) and familiarity with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, high-speed traffic generators). Strong analytical and debugging skills to isolate issues between hardware defects, firmware bugs, test software, and fixture/cabling failures. Experience writing clear engineering documentation, test procedures (SOPs), and technical root-cause reports. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; readiness to support global manufacturing sites (including occasional international travel for line bring-up). Proven hands-on experience integrating ATE platforms and automated test tools with Contract Manufacturers MES, QMS , and Shop Floor Control (SFC) systems for automated serialization, unit routing, and quality data logging. Preferred Qualification

jobs.description: ﻿ Material Planner | Drivenets Home » Careers » Material Planner Material Planner GSC Raanana, Israel Full-time Description ﻿#Hybrid DriveNets is a leader in high-scale disaggregated networking solutions. Founded in 2015, DriveNets modernizes the way service providers, cloud providers, and hyperscalers build networks. Supporting the largest network in the world, more than half of AT&T's backbone traffic is running on DriveNets' Network Cloud open disaggregated architecture. Raising $587 million in three funding rounds, DriveNets is disrupting the networking market from high-scale architecture to AI platforms, and is bringing onboard the most talented people. We are seeking people that want to make an impact on the world's leading communication networks and are experienced in networking architecture or AI infrastructure solutions. 1. Role Purpose The Material Planner is the operational owner of the Contract Manufacturer (CM) relationship for materials working closely with CMs to build the material forecast and to resolve material availability gaps and shortages. The role receives the products forecast from Global Demand Supply (covering CMs, ODMs, and other supply partners) and translates it into supply for each CM and plans the consigned material demand-supply for CM and ODM partners. Works with Engineering to keep the Finished Goods NS BOMs updated reflecting the product’s consigned parts. Reports to the Global Demand supply (S&OP) mgr, feeding CM supply plan and supply commit status into the company’s consolidated supply-demand picture. 2. Core Responsibilities 2.1 Material Forecast & CM Interface • Receive the products forecast from Global Demand Supply (for CMs, ODMs, and other supply partners) and translate it into the consigned material demand-supply plan. • Build and maintain the material forecast with CMs; work with them continuously to identify and resolve material availability gaps and shortages. • Own the CM’s supply plan and supply commit; report status and risks back to Global Demand Supply for the company supply-demand picture. 2.2 Consigned Material & BOM Management • Plan consigned material demand and supply for CM/ODM partners based on the products forecast. • Update, together with Engineering, the Finished Goods NS BOMs to reflect the product’s consigned parts. • Keep consigned-part records aligned between ERP/PLM and CM systems. 2.3 Subcontractor & Supply Partner Management • Act as the primary day-to-day owner for all material preparedness with the Contract Manufacturer (CM) for materials and with the ODM on consigned parts. • Execute procurement policies — order frequency, batch sizes, lead-time commitments, and pricing structures (NRE, unit cost, tooling) — within the commercial framework set by the Global Planning Manager. • Manage quarterly and annual capacity allocation agreements, ensuring CM partners secure manufacturing slots aligned with forecast. • Track CM KPIs (on-time delivery, cost variance, flexibility to demand changes); lead business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) with subcontractors and drive corrective action plans; prepare quarterly CM reconciliation for Global Planning Manager approval. • Support end-of-life (EOL) and new product introduction (NPI) supply strategies in collaboration with Product, HW R&D, Engineering, and the Global Planning Manager. 2.4 Inventory & Continuity of Supply • Set and maintain safety stock policies globally, balancing service level targets against inventory carrying cost. • Monitor excess & obsolete (E&O) inventory and drive disposition actions (rework, scrap, resale). • Develop multi-source strategies for single-source components to reduce supply concentration risk. • Ensure component-level visibility for critical long-lead items (ASICs, Memories, power components) and manage buffer strategies accordingly. 2.5 Capacity Planning & Ramp Management • Translate product roadmap milestones into manufacturing capacity requirements (line capacity, test capacity, packaging). • Negotiate and document capacity commitments with Supply partners — including upside flexibility clauses — and report them to the Global Planning Manager for governance approval. • Lead ramp-up planning for new product introductions: yield ramp, volume milestones, qualification gates. Requirements • 4+ years in Materials Planning, Supply planning in a hardware company. • Hands-on experience managing Contract Manufacturer (CM) relationships forecasting, material availability, shortages, and consigned inventory. • Working knowledge of BOM structures, PLM/ERP systems, and engineering change processes. • Strong Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with forecast and inventory data at part-number level. • Familiar with AI tools, using AI tools • Fluent in English; clear written and verbal communication with CM/ODM counterparts and internal engineering teams. Preferred • Experience working with EMS/CM - contract manufacturing • Experience in hardware companies, PCBA/box-build environments. • Exposure to AI-based planning or forecasting tools. Skills • Detail-oriented, with strong follow-through on shortages and exceptions. • Effective cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Procurement, and CMs/ODMs. • Data-driven; comfortable with ERP/PLM tooling and BOM management. In this role, you will lead end-to-end mechanical execution from late-stage R&D through volume manufacturing at global EMS/ODM facilities. Design, validate, and commission mechanical assembly jigs, alignment fixtures, and high efficiancy tooling to ensure repeatable line assembly. Advanced Packaging, Palletization & Logistics Engineering: Design and validate primary and secondary packaging solutions, including custom cushioning (EPE/EPP foam), corrugated structures, and chassis transit protection. Define ESD shielding, Moisture Barrier Bags (MBB), and desiccant requirements for high-sensitivity optical and electronic assemblies. Optimize palletization patterns, container cube utilization, stacking strength calculations, and pallet weight distribution for global freight. Plan, execute, and certify transit/drop testing in accordance with international standards. Manage day-to-day shipping deviations, packaging waivers, and disposition of in-transit damage. Labeling & Regulatory Compliance Integration: Design unit, carton, and pallet labels; select and qualify label substrates, adhesives, and print ribbons for environmental durability (abrasion, high temperature, humidity, UV resistance per UL standards). Manage the physical integration and placement of global regulatory markings on chassis surfaces, rating plates, and packaging. Thermal Management & Liquid Cooling Architecture: Address mechanical-thermal integration challenges within high-power chassis and optical cages . Oversee mechanical validation and assembly of Liquid Cooling systems for high-density compute/switching gear, including cold plates, manifolds, quick disconnects , hoses/piping routing, fluid loop integrity, and leak detection mechanisms. Evaluate Thermal Interface Materials (TIMs), clamping force distribution, and flatness tolerances across high-power ASICs. Supplier Quality, Sourcing & On-Site Audits: Qualify mechanical fabrication vendors, sheet metal suppliers, precision machine shops, and server/telecom rack manufacturers. Conduct on-site factory and supplier capability audits across Tier-1 EMS and ODM sites (evaluating stamping, CNC, die-casting, plating, painting, and assembly environments). Review and sign off on First Article Inspections (FAI), packages, CMM dimensional reports, and material certifications . Define Incoming Quality Control (IQC) inspection plans for mech items, Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) dimensions, and AQL sampling standards. Production Support, Failure Analysis & Sustaining Engineering: Provide active mechanical line support, quickly resolving production line stops, component mismatches, and Material Review Board (MRB) dispositions. Lead mechanical Failure Analysis (FA), root-cause investigations , and implement robust mech Corrective/Preventive Actions. Drive cost-reduction redesigns. Qualify mechanical second sources to mitigate single-point supply chain risks. Author and manage Engineering Change Orders (ECO/MCO), BOM updates, and CAD revisions for mech items within the company PLM system. Mechanical Reliability & Environmental Qualification: Plan and execute mechanical stress testing. Requirements Education: B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering. Experience: 6+ years of mechanical engineering experience in NPI, manufacturing, and sustaining environments within the networking, telecommunications, server, optics, or data center hardware industries. System Integration Scope: Proven experience managing both box-level / chassis and Rack-level integration . Data Center & Optical Familiarity: Hands-on experience with high-density Ethernet switches, fiber-optic routing, optical transceivers, and high-speed PCB mechanical constraints.
